scope.single_semantic_change: explicit terminal closure of events still open when the source signals end of stream

semantic_contract.classification: control finalization, not acoustic offset detection
semantic_contract.trigger: one explicit end-of-stream signal after the last received sample
semantic_contract.terminal_position: exclusive audio end N for a stream containing samples 0 through N-1
semantic_contract.event_rule: emit one offset(eventId, N) for every eventId still open
semantic_contract.multiplicity: k open events emit k offsets at the same terminal position
semantic_contract.identity: each terminal offset reuses the opaque eventId of its onset
semantic_contract.target_policy: offsets at position frame_count remain excluded from the acoustic sample target
semantic_contract.no_shift: never move an exclusive-end offset to frame_count - 1
semantic_contract.restart_policy: terminal offsets create no restart frame because no future 512-sample frame can exist
semantic_contract.evaluation_policy: report terminal control closures separately from acoustically detected offsets
semantic_contract.real_prediction_guard: a false predicted onset still open at EOF will also receive a terminal closure; oracle compatibility is not model-association accuracy

runtime_contract.atomicity: validate terminal position, event types, unique IDs and the complete open-ID set before mutating scheduler state
runtime_contract.pending_preexisting_restart_frames: remain separate and are not created or reclassified by finalization

post_change_audit.oracle_replay: replay every annotated onset and every internal offset through LiveEventTracker, with offset before onset at equal positions, then finalize at frame_count
required_runtime_tests: multiple open IDs close at one exclusive terminal position with their original IDs
no open ID produces no event
already closed IDs are not duplicated
scheduler rejects partial, duplicate, unknown, non-offset or non-terminal event sets atomically
terminal events create no restart frames
ordinary process_chunk output is unchanged before EOF
processing and finalizing twice are rejected
WAV and stdin EOF call finalization exactly once
